description: Single-panel bar chart (no sub-panels) plotting Strength (MPa) on the vertical axis, 0–1000 with ticks every 200 MPa, against four printed conditions on the horizontal axis: M1-SS, M1-30, M2-SS and M2-30. The boxed legend lists five entries keyed to bar colours: Measured (red), σ0 (blue), σG (purple), σOr (green) and σS (yellow). Each condition is drawn as a pair of bars: a solid red "Measured" bar, and beside it a stacked bar that resolves the calculated yield-strength contributions in the legend order σ0 at the bottom, then σG, then σOr, then σS on top. No numeric data labels are printed on any bar, so all values are read against the gridlines. For M1-SS both bars end just above the 400 MPa gridline and the stack contains only σ0 and σG. For M1-30 the measured bar lies between the 800 and 1000 MPa gridlines; its stack is of similar total height, with σ0 + σG ending below the 500 MPa level and a large yellow σS segment filling up to slightly above the 800 MPa gridline, with no green σOr segment. M2-SS measured bar lies between 600 and 800 MPa, its stack showing σ0, σG and a green σOr top segment but no yellow σS. M2-30 has the tallest bars (measured near the 900 MPa level), stacked as σ0 + σG + σOr + σS. The figure demonstrates that the calculated mechanism contributions sum to the measured yield strength, and that aging raises strength chiefly through σS for M1 and through σOr + σS for M2.

observations.observation: The chart's vertical axis is labelled 'Strength(MPa)' and is scaled 0–1000 with gridline ticks every 200 MPa; the horizontal axis carries four categorical labels printed as M1-SS, M1-30, M2-SS and M2-30.
The legend contains exactly five entries: Measured (red), σ0 (blue), σG (purple), σOr (green) and σS (yellow).
Every condition is rendered as a pair of bars: a solid red bar for the 'Measured' value and an adjacent stacked bar built from σ0, σG, σOr and σS segments.

The two aged conditions M1-30 and M2-30 have measured bars lying between the 800 and 1000 MPa gridlines, whereas M1-SS lies just above the 400 MPa gridline and M2-SS lies between the 600 and 800 MPa gridlines.
For each of the four conditions the total height of the stacked bar closely matches the height of its paired red 'Measured' bar.
The green σOr segment appears only in the M2-SS and M2-30 stacks, and the yellow σS segment appears only in the M1-30 and M2-30 stacks; the M1-SS stack contains only σ0 and σG.
The blue σ0 segment is the lowest segment in all four stacks, ending below the 400 MPa gridline for M1-SS and M1-30 and just above the 400 MPa gridline for M2-SS and M2-30.
The caption states that the figure presents the contributions of different strengthening mechanisms to the yield strength of the M1 and M2 steel.
The citing text states that after aging treatment the increase in yield strength of M1 is mainly due to the shear strengthening of the κ-carbides.

The citing text states that with Ti and V addition the volume fraction of κ-carbides is reduced, lowering the contribution of shear strengthening, while the bypass strengthening of (Ti, V)C carbides supplements this strength.
The citing text states that the strengthening mechanism of κ-carbides precipitating attached to (Ti, V)C carbides exhibits little difference from that of κ-carbides precipitating uniformly.
No numeric values are printed on the bars, so the mechanism contributions can only be ranked and read against the 200 MPa gridlines, not quoted exactly.
